code_summary: Intended architecture: one independently trained LightGCN per category, with softmax-normalized layer_logits jointly learning shared user/item propagation-depth weights. Zero logits initialize uniform depth weighting. Retains supervised-edge masking, recency-aware history attention, history_last query projection, gated history fusion, tied item vectors, and item bias; removes history_residual. The predictor routes all four categories and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category, including layer_logits and history_last.weight. Diagnostics target initial propagation parity, finite gradients, and serialization prediction parity. No ensemble or separately fitted auxiliary scorer is intended.
